messages.summary:
## Objective
Build a production-ready PWA called **PulseBoard** in an empty directory — a minimalist personal daily overview where users tick off activities/habits and see daily progress. React + TypeScript + Vite, no backend, IndexedDB persistence, offline-capable, responsive, installable PWA.

## Requirements
- React + TS + Vite, PWA-capable, no backend, local browser storage (IndexedDB), offline-capable, responsive (desktop + mobile).
- Functions: manage activities (add/edit/delete; name, optional description, category, optional daily goal); daily status (tick for current day, persist across reload, per-day isolation); dashboard (done/open counts, percent, per-category overview); day navigation (today/prev/next, future days displayable but not tickable); persistence (IndexedDB, versioned schema, corrupt data must not crash); PWA (manifest, installable, app name + icons, service worker, offline shell); UX (clean calm design, dark mode, keyboard support, empty states, error messages, no unnecessary animations); quality (automated tests for create/edit/delete/day-status/date-change/persistence/corrupt-data, no TS errors, linting, production build).
- Work autonomously: run tests/lint/build, fix failures, verify final state. No MCPs, no web search, no external tools beyond local project/terminal tools.

## Decisions
- IndexedDB as persistence (single versioned JSON blob under key 'main' in object store 'state', DB 'pulseboard' v1); corrupt data handled via `sanitizeState` (never throws).
- Data model: `Activity` (id, name, description, category, dailyGoal, createdAt); `days: Record<YYYY-MM-DD, DayProgress>` where `DayProgress = Record<activityId, number>`.
- `SCHEMA_VERSION = 1`; `emptyState()` is a **function** returning `StoredState { schemaVersion, activities, days, updatedAt }`.
- Pure logic in `dayLogic.ts`; Vite PWA via `@vitejs/plugin-pwa` enabled only outside test mode (`mode === 'test'` → undefined); vitest uses its own config without PWA.
- Icons as SVG placeholders (192/512/maskable) referenced in manifest; `base: './'`.
- TypeScript project-references (`tsc -b`); ESLint flat config with typescript-eslint + react/react-hooks/react-refresh. Lint rule: `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` = error (`^_` ignored); `react-refresh/only-export-components` = warn; `no-explicit-any` off.
- `vitest`: globals true, environment jsdom, setupFiles `./vitest.setup.ts`, css false, clearMocks/restoreMocks true. `vitest.setup.ts` at repo root (NOT in src/).
- `typecheck` script = `tsc -b --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly false && tsc -noEmit`; `check` = typecheck && lint && test && build. `lint` = `eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx`.
- `crypto.randomUUID()` used in store/logic — must be available in test env.
- Activity rendering rule: goal ≤ 1 → checkbox toggle (`aria-pressed`); goal > 1 → `− count/goal +` stepper (no checkbox); row is `done` when `count >= goal`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Config scaffolding: package.json, .gitignore, tsconfig(.app/.node/.json), vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, eslint.config.js, index.html.
- Core lib: types.ts, dateUtils.ts, dayLogic.ts, storage.ts (all read and verified complete/correct with exact contracts).
- Hooks: useDayStore.ts, useTheme.ts (all read and verified — full `DayStore` interface confirmed).
- Entry: main.tsx (`import App from './App'` → default export required), index.css (full styling incl. dark mode, responsive).
- Icon assets created: `favicon.svg`, `icons/icon-192.svg`, `icons/icon-512.svg`, `icons/icon-512-maskable.svg`.
- Fixed `tsconfig.app.json` to add `"baseUrl": "."` and `"paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }`.
- Leaf UI components created & read for exact props: `ThemeToggle`, `Dashboard` (`{summary, categories}`), `DayNavigation` (`{label, isFuture, onPrev, onNext, onToday}`), `EmptyState` (`{title, message, action?}`), `ErrorBanner` (`{message, onRetry}`), `LoadingState`.
- Read ALL existing files (lib, hooks, components, CSS, configs) to confirm exact interfaces, class names, and props before building remaining components.

### Active
- Building remaining React UI layer: `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx` (add/edit modal), `src/components/ActivityList.tsx` (list + stepper), `src/App.tsx` (composition). Interfaces/patterns now fully confirmed but files NOT yet created.
- `vitest.setup.ts` (repo root) incomplete — only has `cleanup` in `afterEach`. Still needs: matchMedia polyfill, crypto.randomUUID fallback, `fake-indexeddb/auto` import.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx` (modal: name required, description, category, dailyGoal; Escape closes, focus name field, backdrop click closes; props `{ activity?: Activity, onSubmit(input: Omit<Activity,'id'|'createdAt'>), onClose() }`). Use existing CSS classes `.modal-backdrop`, `.modal`, `.add-form`, `.field`, `.row`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.form-actions`.
2. Create `src/components/ActivityList.tsx` (checkbox for goal≤1 with `.activity .check` + `aria-pressed`, stepper for goal>1 with `.goal-stepper`, edit/delete actions in `.activity .actions`, disabled checks/stepper when isFuture; props: activities, progress per-day map, isFuture, onToggle/onChangeCount/onEdit/onDelete).
3. Create `src/App.tsx` wiring `useDayStore` + `useTheme`, composing header, error banner, loading, daynav, dashboard, activity list/empty state, single modal (add+edit via one `modal` state), footer note.
4. Add `.add-btn` CSS (full-width button) to index.css (no such class exists yet).
5. Complete `vitest.setup.ts`: add matchMedia + crypto + fake-indexeddb polyfills.
6. Write tests (Vitest + Testing Library + fake-indexeddb) covering create/edit/delete, day status, date change, persistence (re-render), corrupt data (seed garbage via `closeStore` + `indexedDB.deleteDatabase` + `initStore`/`writeState` reset helper).
7. Run `npm install`, then `npm run check` (typecheck && lint && test && build); fix failures.
8. Verify final state (build output, tests passing).

## Relevant Files
- `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx`: (to create) add/edit modal form.
- `src/components/ActivityList.tsx`: (to create) activity rows with check/stepper/edit/delete.
- `src/components/App.tsx`: (to create) top-level composition of store + theme + all sections.
- `src/index.css`: full styling — components must match existing class names; needs `.add-btn` rule.
- `vitest.setup.ts`: (repo root) complete — matchMedia + crypto + fake-indexeddb polyfills.
- `src/hooks/useDayStore.ts`: central state hook; exact `DayStore` interface (activities, selectedDate/Label/IsFuture, progress, loading, error, reload/addActivity/updateActivity/deleteActivity/toggleDone/changeCount/goTo/goToToday/setDate/importFromJson).
- `src/lib/dayLogic.ts`: pure day/dashboard logic + `sanitizeState` + `getDaySummary`/`getCategoryBreakdown`.
- `src/lib/storage.ts`: versioned IndexedDB store (readState/writeState/CRUD/import/export/closeStore/initStore); cachedDB/initPromise module cache requires closeStore + deleteDatabase for test resets.
- `src/lib/types.ts`: core data model + `emptyState()` fn + `SCHEMA_VERSION`.
- `src/lib/dateUtils.ts`: local-time date helpers (todayLocal, addDays, formatDayLabel, isFuture).
- `src/components/Dashboard.tsx`, `DayNavigation.tsx`, `EmptyState.tsx`, `ErrorBanner.tsx`, `ThemeToggle.tsx`, `LoadingState.tsx`: existing components; match class names and props.

## Important Context
- `toggleDone`/`changeCount` take a full `Activity` object (not just id); future days are blocked from toggling inside the store (`isFuture(selectedDate)` guard).
- `useDayStore` loads state on mount via async `useEffect` — tests must wait for `loading` to finish before asserting (use `findBy*`/`waitFor`).
- `useTheme()` returns `{ theme: 'light'|'dark', toggle }`; uses `window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` (jsdom lacks it → polyfill needed).
- Storage layer already contains `exportData`/`importData` but import/export UI was intentionally NOT added (scope kept to explicit requirements).
- Tests must reset IndexedDB between tests: `closeStore()` + `indexedDB.deleteDatabase('pulseboard')` + re-`initStore()`, since storage module caches the connection (cachedDB/initPromise).
- CSS classes components must match (all confirmed present): `.add-form`, `.field`, `.row`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger-ghost`, `.form-actions`, `.activity`, `.activity.done`, `.activity .check`, `.activity .check[aria-pressed='true']`, `.activity .info`, `.activity .info .name`, `.activity.done .info .name`, `.activity .info .meta`, `.activity .info .desc`, `.tag`, `.goal`, `.activity .actions`, `.activity .actions .del`, `.goal-stepper`, `.goal-stepper button`, `.modal-backdrop`, `.modal`, `.modal h3`, `.footer-note`.
- Working dir: `/Users/cedi/Projekte/llm-bench/models/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b-mlx-test1` (git repo, main branch, clean; nothing committed yet, no node_modules). Node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0.

messages.summary:
## Objective
Build a production-ready PWA called **PulseBoard** in an empty directory — a minimalist personal daily overview where users tick off activities/habits and see daily progress. React + TypeScript + Vite, no backend, IndexedDB persistence, offline-capable, responsive, installable PWA.

## Requirements
- React + TS + Vite, PWA-capable, no backend, local browser storage (IndexedDB), offline-capable, responsive (desktop + mobile).
- Functions: manage activities (add/edit/delete; name, optional description, category, optional daily goal); daily status (tick for current day, persist across reload, per-day isolation); dashboard (done/open counts, percent, per-category overview); day navigation (today/prev/next, future days displayable but not tickable); persistence (IndexedDB, versioned schema, corrupt data must not crash); PWA (manifest, installable, app name + icons, service worker, offline shell); UX (clean calm design, dark mode, keyboard support, empty states, error messages, no unnecessary animations); quality (automated tests for create/edit/delete/day-status/date-change/persistence/corrupt-data, no TS errors, linting, production build).
- Work autonomously: run tests/lint/build, fix failures, verify final state. No MCPs, no web search, no external tools beyond local project/terminal tools.

## Decisions
- IndexedDB as persistence (single versioned JSON blob under key 'main' in object store 'state', DB 'pulseboard' v1); corrupt data handled via `sanitizeState` (never throws).
- Data model: `Activity` (id, name, description, category, dailyGoal, createdAt); `days: Record<YYYY-MM-DD, DayProgress>` where `DayProgress = Record<activityId, number>`.
- `SCHEMA_VERSION = 1`; `emptyState()` is a **function** returning `StoredState { schemaVersion, activities, days, updatedAt }`.
- Pure logic in `dayLogic.ts`; Vite PWA via `@vitejs/plugin-pwa` enabled only outside test mode (`mode === 'test'` → undefined); vitest uses its own config without PWA.
- Icons as SVG placeholders (192/512/maskable) referenced in manifest; `base: './'`.
- TypeScript project-references (`tsc -b`); ESLint flat config with typescript-eslint + react/react-hooks/react-refresh. Lint rule: `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` = error (`^_` ignored); `react-refresh/only-export-components` = warn; `no-explicit-any` off.
- `vitest`: globals true, environment jsdom, setupFiles `./vitest.setup.ts`, css false, clearMocks/restoreMocks true. `vitest.setup.ts` at repo root (NOT in src/).
- `typecheck` script = `tsc -b --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly false && tsc -noEmit`; `check` = typecheck && lint && test && build. `lint` = `eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx`.
- `crypto.randomUUID()` used in store/logic — must be available in test env.
- Activity rendering rule: goal ≤ 1 → checkbox toggle (`aria-pressed`); goal > 1 → `− count/goal +` stepper (no checkbox); row is `done` when `count >= goal`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Config scaffolding: package.json, .gitignore, tsconfig(.app/.node/.json), vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, eslint.config.js, index.html.
- Core lib: types.ts, dateUtils.ts, dayLogic.ts, storage.ts (all read and verified complete/correct with exact contracts).
- Hooks: useDayStore.ts, useTheme.ts (all read and verified — full `DayStore` interface confirmed).
- Entry: main.tsx (`import App from './App'` → default export required), index.css (full styling incl. dark mode, responsive).
- Icon assets created: `favicon.svg`, `icons/icon-192.svg`, `icons/icon-512.svg`, `icons/icon-512-maskable.svg`.
- Fixed `tsconfig.app.json` to add `"baseUrl": "."` and `"paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }`.
- Leaf UI components created & read for exact props: `ThemeToggle`, `Dashboard` (`{summary, categories}`), `DayNavigation` (`{label, isFuture, onPrev, onNext, onToday}`), `EmptyState` (`{title, message, action?}`), `ErrorBanner` (`{message, onRetry}`), `LoadingState`.
- Read ALL existing files (lib, hooks, components, CSS, configs) to confirm exact interfaces, class names, and props before building remaining components.

### Active
- Building remaining React UI layer: `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx` (add/edit modal), `src/components/ActivityList.tsx` (list + stepper), `src/App.tsx` (composition). Interfaces/patterns now fully confirmed but files NOT yet created.
- `vitest.setup.ts` (repo root) incomplete — only has `cleanup` in `afterEach`. Still needs: matchMedia polyfill, crypto.randomUUID fallback, `fake-indexeddb/auto` import.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx` (modal: name required, description, category, dailyGoal; Escape closes, focus name field, backdrop click closes; props `{ activity?: Activity, onSubmit(input: Omit<Activity,'id'|'createdAt'>), onClose() }`). Use existing CSS classes `.modal-backdrop`, `.modal`, `.add-form`, `.field`, `.row`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.form-actions`.
2. Create `src/components/ActivityList.tsx` (checkbox for goal≤1 with `.activity .check` + `aria-pressed`, stepper for goal>1 with `.goal-stepper`, edit/delete actions in `.activity .actions`, disabled checks/stepper when isFuture; props: activities, progress per-day map, isFuture, onToggle/onChangeCount/onEdit/onDelete).
3. Create `src/App.tsx` wiring `useDayStore` + `useTheme`, composing header, error banner, loading, daynav, dashboard, activity list/empty state, single modal (add+edit via one `modal` state), footer note.
4. Add `.add-btn` CSS (full-width button) to index.css (no such class exists yet).
5. Complete `vitest.setup.ts`: add matchMedia + crypto + fake-indexeddb polyfills.
6. Write tests (Vitest + Testing Library + fake-indexeddb) covering create/edit/delete, day status, date change, persistence (re-render), corrupt data (seed garbage via `closeStore` + `indexedDB.deleteDatabase` + `initStore`/`writeState` reset helper).
7. Run `npm install`, then `npm run check` (typecheck && lint && test && build); fix failures.
8. Verify final state (build output, tests passing).

## Relevant Files
- `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx`: (to create) add/edit modal form.
- `src/components/ActivityList.tsx`: (to create) activity rows with check/stepper/edit/delete.
- `src/components/App.tsx`: (to create) top-level composition of store + theme + all sections.
- `src/index.css`: full styling — components must match existing class names; needs `.add-btn` rule.
- `vitest.setup.ts`: (repo root) complete — matchMedia + crypto + fake-indexeddb polyfills.
- `src/hooks/useDayStore.ts`: central state hook; exact `DayStore` interface (activities, selectedDate/Label/IsFuture, progress, loading, error, reload/addActivity/updateActivity/deleteActivity/toggleDone/changeCount/goTo/goToToday/setDate/importFromJson).
- `src/lib/dayLogic.ts`: pure day/dashboard logic + `sanitizeState` + `getDaySummary`/`getCategoryBreakdown`.
- `src/lib/storage.ts`: versioned IndexedDB store (readState/writeState/CRUD/import/export/closeStore/initStore); cachedDB/initPromise module cache requires closeStore + deleteDatabase for test resets.
- `src/lib/types.ts`: core data model + `emptyState()` fn + `SCHEMA_VERSION`.
- `src/lib/dateUtils.ts`: local-time date helpers (todayLocal, addDays, formatDayLabel, isFuture).
- `src/components/Dashboard.tsx`, `DayNavigation.tsx`, `EmptyState.tsx`, `ErrorBanner.tsx`, `ThemeToggle.tsx`, `LoadingState.tsx`: existing components; match class names and props.

## Important Context
- `toggleDone`/`changeCount` take a full `Activity` object (not just id); future days are blocked from toggling inside the store (`isFuture(selectedDate)` guard).
- `useDayStore` loads state on mount via async `useEffect` — tests must wait for `loading` to finish before asserting (use `findBy*`/`waitFor`).
- `useTheme()` returns `{ theme: 'light'|'dark', toggle }`; uses `window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` (jsdom lacks it → polyfill needed).
- Storage layer already contains `exportData`/`importData` but import/export UI was intentionally NOT added (scope kept to explicit requirements).
- Tests must reset IndexedDB between tests: `closeStore()` + `indexedDB.deleteDatabase('pulseboard')` + re-`initStore()`, since storage module caches the connection (cachedDB/initPromise).
- CSS classes components must match (all confirmed present): `.add-form`, `.field`, `.row`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger-ghost`, `.form-actions`, `.activity`, `.activity.done`, `.activity .check`, `.activity .check[aria-pressed='true']`, `.activity .info`, `.activity .info .name`, `.activity.done .info .name`, `.activity .info .meta`, `.activity .info .desc`, `.tag`, `.goal`, `.activity .actions`, `.activity .actions .del`, `.goal-stepper`, `.goal-stepper button`, `.modal-backdrop`, `.modal`, `.modal h3`, `.footer-note`.
- Working dir: `/Users/cedi/Projekte/llm-bench/models/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b-mlx-test1` (git repo, main branch, clean; nothing committed yet, no node_modules). Node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0.

## Objective
Build a production-ready PWA called **PulseBoard** in an empty directory — a minimalist personal daily overview where users tick off activities/habits and see daily progress. React + TypeScript + Vite, no backend, IndexedDB persistence, offline-capable, responsive, installable PWA.

## Requirements
- React + TS + Vite, PWA-capable, no backend, local browser storage (IndexedDB), offline-capable, responsive (desktop + mobile).
- Functions: manage activities (add/edit/delete; name, optional description, category, optional daily goal); daily status (tick for current day, persist across reload, per-day isolation); dashboard (done/open counts, percent, per-category overview); day navigation (today/prev/next, future days displayable but not tickable); persistence (IndexedDB, versioned schema, corrupt data must not crash); PWA (manifest, installable, app name + icons, service worker, offline shell); UX (clean calm design, dark mode, keyboard support, empty states, error messages, no unnecessary animations); quality (automated tests for create/edit/delete/day-status/date-change/persistence/corrupt-data, no TS errors, linting, production build).
- Work autonomously: run tests/lint/build, fix failures, verify final state. No MCPs, no web search, no external tools beyond local project/terminal tools.

## Decisions
- IndexedDB as persistence (single versioned JSON blob under key 'main' in object store 'state', DB 'pulseboard' v1); corrupt data handled via `sanitizeState` (never throws).
- Data model: `Activity` (id, name, description, category, dailyGoal, createdAt); `days: Record<YYYY-MM-DD, DayProgress>` where `DayProgress = Record<activityId, number>`.
- `SCHEMA_VERSION = 1`; `emptyState()` is a **function** returning `StoredState { schemaVersion, activities, days, updatedAt }`.
- Pure logic in `dayLogic.ts`; Vite PWA via `@vitejs/plugin-pwa` enabled only outside test mode (`mode === 'test'` → undefined); vitest uses its own config without PWA.
- Icons as SVG placeholders (192/512/maskable) referenced in manifest; `base: './'`.
- TypeScript project-references (`tsc -b`); ESLint flat config with typescript-eslint + react/react-hooks/react-refresh. Lint rule: `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` = error (`^_` ignored); `react-refresh/only-export-components` = warn; `no-explicit-any` off.
- `typecheck` script = `tsc -b --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly false && tsc -noEmit`; `check` = typecheck && lint && test && build. `lint` = `eslint . --ext .ts,.tsx`.
- `vitest`: globals true, environment jsdom, setupFiles `./vitest.setup.ts`, css false, clearMocks/restoreMocks true. `vitest.setup.ts` at repo root (NOT in src/).
- `crypto.randomUUID()` used in store/logic — must be available in test env.
- Activity rendering rule: goal ≤ 1 → checkbox toggle (`aria-pressed`); goal > 1 → `− count/goal +` stepper (no checkbox); row is `done` when `count >= goal`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Config scaffolding: package.json, .gitignore, tsconfig(.app/.node/.json), vite.config.ts, vitest.config.ts, eslint.config.js, index.html.
- Core lib: types.ts, dateUtils.ts, dayLogic.ts, storage.ts (all read and verified complete/correct with exact contracts).
- Hooks: useDayStore.ts, useTheme.ts (all read and verified — full `DayStore` interface confirmed).
- Entry: main.tsx (`import App from './App'` → default export required), index.css (full styling incl. dark mode, responsive).
- Icon assets created: `favicon.svg`, `icons/icon-192.svg`, `icons/icon-512.svg`, `icons/icon-512-maskable.svg`.
- Fixed `tsconfig.app.json` to add `"baseUrl": "."` and `"paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] }`.
- Leaf UI components created & read for exact props: `ThemeToggle`, `Dashboard` (`{summary, categories}`), `DayNavigation` (`{label, isFuture, onPrev, onNext, onToday}`), `EmptyState` (`{title, message, action?}`), `ErrorBanner` (`{message, onRetry}`), `LoadingState`.
- Read ALL existing files (lib, hooks, components, CSS, configs) to confirm exact interfaces, class names, and props before building remaining components.

### Active
- Building remaining React UI layer: `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx` (add/edit modal), `src/components/ActivityList.tsx` (list + stepper), `src/App.tsx` (composition). Interfaces/patterns now fully confirmed but files NOT yet created.
- `vitest.setup.ts` (repo root) incomplete — only has `cleanup` in `afterEach`. Still needs: matchMedia polyfill, crypto.randomUUID fallback, `fake-indexeddb/auto` import.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx` (modal: name required, description, category, dailyGoal; Escape closes, focus name field, backdrop click closes; props `{ activity?: Activity, onSubmit(input: Omit<Activity,'id'|'createdAt'>), onClose() }`). Use existing CSS classes `.modal-backdrop`, `.modal`, `.add-form`, `.field`, `.row`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.form-actions`.
2. Create `src/components/ActivityList.tsx` (checkbox for goal≤1 with `.activity .check` + `aria-pressed`, stepper for goal>1 with `.goal-stepper`, edit/delete actions in `.activity .actions`, disabled checks/stepper when isFuture; props: activities, progress per-day map, isFuture, onToggle/onChangeCount/onEdit/onDelete).
3. Create `src/App.tsx` wiring `useDayStore` + `useTheme`, composing header, error banner, loading, daynav, dashboard, activity list/empty state, single modal (add+edit via one `modal` state), footer note.
4. Add `.add-btn` CSS (full-width button) to index.css (no such class exists yet).
5. Complete `vitest.setup.ts`: add matchMedia + crypto + fake-indexeddb polyfills.
6. Write tests (Vitest + Testing Library + fake-indexeddb) covering create/edit/delete, day status, date change, persistence (re-render), corrupt data (seed garbage via `closeStore` + `indexedDB.deleteDatabase` + `initStore`/`writeState` reset helper).
7. Run `npm install`, then `npm run check` (typecheck && lint && test && build); fix failures.
8. Verify final state (build output, tests passing).

## Relevant Files
- `src/components/ActivityForm.tsx`: (to create) add/edit modal form.
- `src/components/ActivityList.tsx`: (to create) activity rows with check/stepper/edit/delete.
- `src/App.tsx`: (to create) top-level composition of store + theme + all sections.
- `src/index.css`: full styling — components must match existing class names; needs `.add-btn` rule.
- `vitest.setup.ts`: (repo root) complete — matchMedia + crypto + fake-indexeddb polyfills.
- `src/hooks/useDayStore.ts`: central state hook; exact `DayStore` interface (activities, selectedDate/Label/IsFuture, progress, loading, error, reload/addActivity/updateActivity/deleteActivity/toggleDone/changeCount/goTo/goToToday/setDate/importFromJson).
- `src/lib/dayLogic.ts`: pure day/dashboard logic + `sanitizeState` + `getDaySummary`/`getCategoryBreakdown`.
- `src/lib/storage.ts`: versioned IndexedDB store (readState/writeState/CRUD/import/export/closeStore/initStore); cachedDB/initPromise module cache requires closeStore + deleteDatabase for test resets.
- `src/lib/types.ts`: core data model + `emptyState()` fn + `SCHEMA_VERSION`.
- `src/lib/dateUtils.ts`: local-time date helpers (todayLocal, addDays, formatDayLabel, isFuture).

## Important Context
- `toggleDone`/`changeCount` take a full `Activity` object (not just id); future days are blocked from toggling inside the store (`isFuture(selectedDate)` guard).
- `useDayStore` loads state on mount via async `useEffect` — tests must wait for `loading` to finish before asserting (use `findBy*`/`waitFor`).
- `useTheme()` returns `{ theme: 'light'|'dark', toggle }`; uses `window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` (jsdom lacks it → polyfill needed).
- Storage layer already contains `exportData`/`importData` but import/export UI was intentionally NOT added (scope kept to explicit requirements).
- Tests must reset IndexedDB between tests: `closeStore()` + `indexedDB.deleteDatabase('pulseboard')` + re-`initStore()`, since storage module caches the connection (cachedDB/initPromise).
- CSS classes components must match (all confirmed present): `.add-form`, `.field`, `.row`, `.btn`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-danger-ghost`, `.form-actions`, `.activity`, `.activity.done`, `.activity .check`, `.activity .check[aria-pressed='true']`, `.activity .info`, `.activity .info .name`, `.activity.done .info .name`, `.activity .info .meta`, `.activity .info .desc`, `.tag`, `.goal`, `.activity .actions`, `.activity .actions .del`, `.goal-stepper`, `.goal-stepper button`, `.modal-backdrop`, `.modal`, `.modal h3`, `.footer-note`.
- Working dir: `/Users/cedi/Projekte/llm-bench/models/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b/ornith-1.5-35b-a3b-mlx-test1` (git repo, main branch, clean; nothing committed yet, no node_modules). Node v24.21.0, npm 11.19.0.

- Work autonomously: run tests/lint/build, fix failures, verify final state. No MCPs, no web search, no external tools beyond local project/terminal tools.
